description: A filter whose frequency response morphs continuously between low pass, band pass and high pass, with three separate pitch modulation inputs.

params.text: How much the FQ1 jack moves the cutoff. With nothing patched into FQ1 this knob is a fine tune on the cutoff instead.
How much the FQ2 jack moves the cutoff.
How much the third modulation input moves the cutoff.
How much the Q jack moves the resonance.
Chooses the shape of the response: up is low pass, middle is band pass, down is high pass.

inputs.text: Moves the resonance, by as much as the MOD knob beside Q allows.
Moves the cutoff, at one volt per octave with the MOD 2 knob fully up.
Moves the cutoff, at one volt per octave with the MOD knob beside FQ fully up.
Moves the cutoff, at one volt per octave with the first MOD 1 knob fully up.
Audio into the filter, left side.
Audio into the filter, right side.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
